name: SendTextSms
description: Sends an SMS using Twilio service
author: @gaurav

fields.name: __CredentialId__Twilio
fields.label: Twilio Credential
fields.description: The Twilio credential containing valid auth token and accountsId which is used to authenticate API requests.

fields.name: recipientType
fields.label: Recipient Identification Method
fields.description: Specify how to identify the recipient of the WhatsApp message: by phone number or by Messaging Service SID.

selectOptions.label: Phone Number
selectOptions.description: Choose this option to identify the recipient using their phone number.

selectOptions.label: Messaging Service SID
selectOptions.description: Choose this option to identify the recipient using their unique Twilio Messaging Service SID.

fields.name: recipientTypeValue
fields.label: Sender Phone Number / Messaging Service SID
fields.description: Enter the Twilio phone number or service identifier from which the message will be sent.

fields.name: toNumber
fields.label: To Number
fields.description: The phone number to send the message to the number (Twilio number).

fields.name: messageBody
fields.label: Message Body
fields.description: The body of the SMS message.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the response data from twilio after sending the text sms.
